notes.text: TRIAGED (source review 2026-08-09, confidence high): Benilla defines the item wire: template query/response, use/open/auto-equip/auto-store/swap/swap-inv/split/destroy/set-ammo bodies, and the SMSG_INVENTORY_CHANGE_FAILURE + SMSG_ITEM_ENCHANT_TIME_UPDATE reads. MSUI implements the query pair, CMSG_USE_ITEM, CMSG_AUTOEQUIP_ITEM, CMSG_SWAP_ITEM, CMSG_SWAP_INV_ITEM, CMSG_SPLIT_ITEM, CMSG_SET_AMMO, and handles SMSG_ITEM_PUSH_RESULT.
